glosses: mount; a mountain or large hill
pile; heap (a mass of things placed together so as to form a mass or elevation)
heap; load; pile (a great amount of something)

examples.en: I want a whole lot of money.

examples.text: Já fiz isso um monte de vezes.
examples.en: I've already done that a lot of times.

examples.text: Tom tem um monte de roupas.
Eu tiro um monte de fotos.
examples.en: I take a lot of pictures.
